summary: Valion Bio, Inc. filed a Form 8-K on October 1, 2026, disclosing under Item 8.01 a press release dated September 30, 2026, announcing completion of formulation work for a novel oral mucosal version of Entolimod using Shear Kershman Laboratories' proprietary BioViscid drug-delivery platform. No financial terms, stake, price per share, premium, advisor, or board recommendation were stated. The filing is an ordinary product-development update, not a special situation. The risk-arb angle is limited to clinical and regulatory execution for a needle-free alternative to Valion's injectable Entolimod; no deal terms or transactional mechanics apply.
